remarks: Bring your vision and toolbox. This vacant property is ready for a full renovation and offers a clean slate for an investor, flipper, or owner-occupant who wants to build equity. Sold as-is with no repairs or warranties. Cash, hard-money, or renovation financing preferred.Solid bones and a functional layout give you room to reconfigure, update systems, and finish to your specs. Immediate occupancy means you can start work right away—no tenants, no delays.Great chance to add value in an established neighborhood. Schedule a walkthrough, inspect thoroughly, and make your offer. This one won’t last for buyers looking for a project they can control from the ground up.
